sources.notes: Uses representation-aligned tactile grounding and future tactile prediction at intermediate action-expert features.
Uses force-guided tactile foresight, compact latent prediction, and tactile-guided gating.
Frames multimodal training as representation compatibility rather than modality scaling.
Uses tactile distillation to train a policy that does not require tactile input at inference time.

terms.why: Recent vocabulary for choosing the internal policy layer at which future-touch supervision is applied.
Distinguishes global wrist force/torque conditioning from local tactile prediction.
Names the emerging finding that structured compatible representations matter more than adding more modalities.
Covers training-time physical sensing that is removed from the deployment sensor stack.
